purpose: Provide an explicit concurrent scope for the exact-main activation repair that reuses the already validated model token from the active local API runtime instead of requiring an unprovisioned model-host SSH key.
requiredBehavior: recover the model token only from the single active API container
validate the token against the expected model URL, model identity and private health endpoint
remove runner model transport files before mutation
preserve exact-main, rollback and least-privilege controller authority
publish no model token or private key material
forbiddenCapabilities: private SSH key transport through GitHub Actions
model token output or artifact publication
